golden_fixtures.description: Steep prior advance, short countertrend parallel channel, close above upper trendline.
Reject a flag-like channel without a steep prior advance.
Reject a valid flag formation before price closes above the upper trendline.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Steep, quick price trend
rules.interpreted_rule: Require a steep, quick advance before a Bull Flag formation.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The book gives a qualitative steep/quick rule; the percentage threshold is a scanner calibration parameter.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Price action bounded by two parallel trend lines.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require the flag body to fit a short channel bounded by approximately parallel trendlines.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Exact slope tolerance is scanner policy and must be reported in the detector parameters.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Flags are short, from a few days to 3 weeks.
rules.interpreted_rule: Reject formations that last longer than three trading weeks.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Three weeks is implemented as approximately 15 trading sessions.

rules.evidence_excerpt: They rise in a down-trend and fall in an uptrend
rules.interpreted_rule: For Bull Flags, the flag body should drift sideways to downward against the prior advance.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The source notes exceptions are common, so this is a strong preference rather than an absolute visual claim.

rules.evidence_excerpt: price closes outside the flag trend line
rules.interpreted_rule: Confirm a Bull Flag only when price closes above the upper flag trendline.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The source says outside the trend line; upward continuation uses the upper trendline.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Volume usually trends downward throughout the formation.
rules.interpreted_rule: Record falling volume during the flag as a context feature, but do not make it a hard gate.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The text says volume is usually downward but not inviolate.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Calculate the price difference between the start of the trend and the formation.
rules.interpreted_rule: Compute the legacy pole-height measure rule from the start of the prior advance to the flag formation, then keep fractional targets as Vietnam calibration bands.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The 1.0x pole-height is retained as a legacy benchmark; 0.46x/0.5x are Bulkowski-adjusted/local calibration bands and must be labeled as such.

rules.evidence_excerpt: If you do not have a strong advance or decline leading to the chart pattern, ignore the flag.
rules.interpreted_rule: Invalidate Bull Flag candidates that do not follow a strong advance.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: This is the explicit inverse of the steep-prior-trend identification rule.

golden_fixtures.description: Steep prior decline, short countertrend parallel channel, close below lower trendline.
Reject a flag-like channel without a steep prior decline.
Reject a valid bear flag formation before price closes below the lower trendline.

rules.evidence_excerpt: price closes outside the flag trend line

rules.evidence_excerpt: Volume usually trends downward throughout the formation.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Calculate the price difference between the start of the trend and the formation.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Price trends downward leading to the double bottom.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require a downward trend into the first bottom before accepting a Double Bottom candidate.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Operational threshold remains local-market calibrated; direction of prior trend is source-grounded.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Double bottom pattern with narrow or spike bottoms.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require two lows that form the double-bottom structure.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Variant-specific shape is handled by Adam/Eve rules below.

rules.evidence_excerpt: At least 10% from the lowest valley to the highest peak between the two bottoms.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require meaningful rise from the lower bottom to the neckline; 10% is the source-grounded publication filter.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Scanner may detect lower-height exploratory candidates, but source-aligned publication scope uses this gate when sample depth permits.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Bottom to bottom price variation is small.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require the two bottom lows to be close enough in price to represent a retest, not two unrelated lows.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Bulkowski reports performance variation by price difference; exact tolerance is local-market calibrated.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Bottoms should be at least a few weeks apart. Best performance came from bottoms between 2 and 6 weeks apart.
rules.interpreted_rule: Keep two bottoms as distinct minor lows; source-aligned scope prefers roughly 2-6 weeks and treats wider than 8 weeks cautiously.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The legacy variant builder uses a wider 15-56 bar publication envelope to avoid overfitting the Vietnam sample.

rules.evidence_excerpt: A close above the confirmation point is the breakout and confirms the pattern as a valid double bottom.
rules.interpreted_rule: Count the event only after close-confirmed breakout above the highest high between the bottoms.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Intraday line touches are not enough for publication statistics.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Compute the height from the highest high to the lowest low in the formation and add the difference to the highest high.
rules.interpreted_rule: Measure-rule target is formation height added to the confirmation point for upward double-bottom breakouts.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: The local chapter may also show fractional target bands, but full-height remains the source reference.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Throwbacks occur about half the time and return to the confirmation price.
rules.interpreted_rule: Report throwback/retest behavior as a core post-breakout statistic, not as a decorative appendix.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Requires path-level OHLCV after breakout.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Usually higher on the left bottom than the right. Bottoms with higher left volume perform better.
rules.interpreted_rule: Track left-versus-right bottom volume as a context metric; do not reject solely because right-bottom volume is higher.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Used as diagnostic/context until volume-quality scoring is source-audited.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Adam is a narrow, V-shaped, perhaps pointed-looking bottom, sometimes a long one- or two-day spike.
rules.interpreted_rule: Classify Adam bottoms as narrow/V-shaped or spike-like extremes.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Variant classifier must retain confidence and allow unclassified cases.

rules.evidence_excerpt: The right Eve bottom appears rounded and wider; Eve typically has several short price spikes.
rules.interpreted_rule: Classify Eve bottoms as wider/rounded extreme zones with multiple short spikes when present.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Variant classifier must preserve left/right order.

rules.evidence_excerpt: For AEDBs, the Adam bottom must be on the left and the Eve bottom on the right.
rules.interpreted_rule: For the Adam & Eve chapter, require variant code AE: left bottom Adam, right bottom Eve.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Do not reuse Adam & Adam source notes for Adam & Eve variants.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Upward price trend
rules.interpreted_rule: Require an upward trend into the first top before accepting a Double Top candidate.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Top chapters repeatedly state that price must trend upward into the pattern.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Two well-defined peaks
rules.interpreted_rule: Require two top pivots that define the double-top structure.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Near-same-price tolerance needs identification-table provenance before official activation.

rules.evidence_excerpt: The valley depth usually measures in the 10% to 20% range, but allow exceptions.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require a meaningful decline from the higher top to the confirmation valley; 10% is the source-grounded publication filter when sample depth permits.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Scanner may retain lower-height exploratory candidates, but publication scopes should disclose the height filter.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Top to top price variation is small, usually 0% to 3%, but allow higher differences.
rules.interpreted_rule: Require the two top highs to be close enough in price to represent a retest, not two unrelated peaks.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Exact tolerance remains local-market calibrated; source text allows exceptions.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Tops should be at least a few weeks apart with most falling in the 2-7 week range.
rules.interpreted_rule: Keep two tops as distinct minor highs; source-aligned scope prefers roughly 2-7 weeks and treats wider formations cautiously.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Eve & Eve chapter gives 2-6 weeks; use 2-7 as the broad family envelope.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Confirmation is a close below the lowest low between the two tops.
rules.interpreted_rule: Count the event only after close-confirmed breakout below the valley between the tops.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Intraday touches are not enough for publication statistics.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Price must close below the confirmation point without first rising above the right top high.
rules.interpreted_rule: Invalidate a Double Top candidate if price rises above the right top high before confirming below the neckline.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: This rule prevents failed twin peaks from entering publication statistics.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Breakout is downward.

rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Breakout level and pullback handling need a dedicated identification-table pass.

rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Variant classifier must retain confidence and preserve left/right order.

rules.evidence_excerpt: The Eve peak is wider and more rounded, perhaps composed of several short spikes.
rules.interpreted_rule: Classify Eve tops as wider/rounded extreme zones with multiple short spikes when present.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Variant-specific chapters must preserve the Adam/Eve order.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Top volume usually higher on the left top.
rules.interpreted_rule: Track left-versus-right top volume as a context metric; do not reject solely because right-top volume is higher.
rules.notes_when_ambiguous: Some Double Top variants report different volume surprises, so this remains context rather than a hard gate.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Measure the height of the pipe and add it to the highest high.

rules.evidence_excerpt: The pattern confirms when price closes below the lowest low in the pattern.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Two downward price spikes separated by a week.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Formation should look like an inverted horn.

rules.evidence_excerpt: Price closes above the highest high in the three-week pattern.
